subject: MSA / Order Form: proposed security exhibit redlines + evidence window proposal
messages:
From: Samantha Reid <security@bluemantlebio.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Larsen <tom.larsen@bluemantlebio.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit + SOC 2 / pen test language for MSA

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As we move toward finalizing the order form and the MSA, our security team has a couple of asks we need baked into the security exhibit:

- Standard SOC 2 Type II report delivery cadence (annual with the right to request the latest report within 30 days).
- Pen test: ability to perform a black-box external assessment annually, with a 30-day notice period; we also need clarity on whether Redwood will accept a vulnerability disclosure timeline and remediation SLA for high/critical findings.
- Audit rights: scoped to our tenant/data for a bounded inspection; we prefer sampling rather than full system inspection and want agreed windows for staging access.

I attached our questionnaire (BlueMantle_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) with line-by-line asks. Could you circulate redlines you propose for the exhibit and the order form amendment?

Two logistical constraints to note: (1) we are in a GxP environment so pen test timing needs to avoid release freezes (we can provide blackout weeks), and (2) evidence handoff has to go through our compliance Slack channel, not by email in many cases.

Appreciate any draft language you can share today or tomorrow.

Best,
Samantha Reid
Director, Security & Compliance
BlueMantle Bio

Attachment: BlueMantle_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Reid <security@bluemantlebio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + SOC 2 / pen test language for MSA

Samantha —

Thanks for the clear asks and for the questionnaire. I’ve pulled together a short playbook draft and attached a PDF with line-level redlines for the security exhibit and a brief order-form amendment we can route. High-level responses here so you have visibility before legal reviews:

- SOC 2: Redwood is happy to provide an annual SOC 2 Type II report. We propose compliance delivery within 30 days of request for the most recent report, with a confidentiality carveout and limited distribution to named recipients only.
- Pen test: we can accept an annual external assessment. We prefer a 45-day notice in our standard language to account for scheduling and coordination; we can tighten to 30 days if BlueMantle requires. Redwood asks that tests exclude production-affecting destructive techniques and that proof-of-concept evidence be coordinated through a named ops contact.
- Audit rights / inspection: proposed scoped wording limits inspection to BlueMantle tenant data and systems logically dedicated to BlueMantle under the Order Form. We propose sampling bands (one rolling window per quarter, or two per year for higher-risk assertions) and a standard evidence cadence (owner-designated artifacts delivered on a weekly handoff during the inspection window).

I attached: redlines-msa-exhibit-v1.pdf (line-level), and an orderform-amendment-draft.docx that mirrors the changes. Karthik, can you review the language below and call out any non-starters? Laura — looping you for any CS-side handoff notes (evidence formats, Slack channel integration).

Next steps I suggest: (1) quick legal pass from Karthik, (2) confirm BlueMantle blackout weeks, (3) finalize notice window (30 vs. 45 days), (4) sign amendment + DocuSign.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines-msa-exhibit-v1.pdf, orderform-amendment-draft.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Reid <security@bluemantlebio.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + SOC 2 / pen test language for MSA

Markus / Samantha —

Thanks — I reviewed the draft redlines. I’ve summarized legal’s position and provided alternative language below (keeps BlueMantle’s commercial protections while limiting operational exposure for Redwood):

1) SOC 2 delivery: Accept annual report delivery; restrict distribution to named BlueMantle recipients and require execution of a nondisclosure agreement for any additional recipients. Suggested wording: "Redwood will provide its most recent SOC 2 Type II report upon written request (no more than once per 12-month period). Distribution outside of named BlueMantle representatives requires a written NDA."

2) Pen test timing and scope: We will accept an annual external penetration test limited to external/black-box assessment unless Redwood and customer mutually agree otherwise. Notice: 45 calendar days preferred; we will accept 30 days notice if BlueMantle confirms blackout windows and provides a contact list for ops coordination. Also add explicit prohibition on social-engineering attacks and destructive techniques.

3) Audit / inspection: Propose scoped inspection language limiting inspection to customer-specific resources and logs necessary to validate controls. Include sampling bands: "Customer may request up to two (2) bounded inspections per 12-month period. Each inspection will be scheduled through Redwood’s security team and limited to an agreed evidence window not to exceed five (5) consecutive business days, unless otherwise mutually agreed."

4) Evidence cadence / artifacts: Require evidence manifests (CSV of artifact names + access instructions) to be delivered at least three (3) business days prior to the inspection window. During the window, Redwood will provide read-only access and produce agreed artifacts on a weekly cadence unless the parties agree to an accelerated handoff.

5) Operational protections: Add an escalation path for any high/critical findings with a 72-hour remediation acknowledgement and a 90-day remediation SLA for critical items unless a different timeline is agreed. Redwood reserves the right to redact privileged operational details not necessary for compliance validation.

I attached a short spreadsheet with proposed pen-test exclusions and a suggested remediation timeline (pen-test-scope-proposal.xlsx). If BlueMantle agrees to 45-day notice, that minimizes friction for scheduling and reduces the need for dedicated staging windows.

If these positions are acceptable in principle, Laura — can you capture the evidence handoff process (Slack channel naming, artifact manifest template) so we can include it in the order form amendment? Samantha — please confirm any blackout weeks and whether BlueMantle wants the 30- or 45-day notice.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pen-test-scope-proposal.xlsx
From: Samantha Reid <security@bluemantlebio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Larsen <tom.larsen@bluemantlebio.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit + SOC 2 / pen test language for MSA

Karthik — thanks for the clear alternatives, they map to what we need. BlueMantle is willing to accept 45 days notice for the first year provided Redwood agrees to 30 days after year one if the scheduling history is clean. We confirm the following:

- Blackout weeks: 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-30; and 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-14. We will provide dates for 2027 on Jan 10.
- We want the 72-hour acknowledgement and 90-day remediation SLA for critical items; we'd like that to be contractual.
- Evidence handoff via compliance Slack channel works; we’ll share the channel and the artifact manifest template by end of day.

Please proceed with an updated redline that: (a) sets notice at 45 days with conditional reduction to 30 days after 12 months, (b) includes the remediation timelines, and (c) adds the evidence-manifest requirement. We’re ok to sign the orderform amendment once those three items are in the exhibit.

— Samantha
Samantha Reid
Director, Security & Compliance
BlueMantle Bio
